honest_disclaimer: This is an empirical LLM self-assessment of 12 papers accepted to YSA Vol.10. It is NOT a tier prediction, NOT a Yau/NeurIPS/CCF mapping, NOT a percentile against any real submission pool, NOT a threshold for acceptance. The 'YSA-10 STEM level' here means 'the empirical distribution of LLM self-scores for n=12 accepted papers in this specific volume'. Any future paper scoring within or above this distribution is *consistent with* — not *sufficient for* — acceptance at this venue. The skill author (Mavis) explicitly does not predict acceptance at any venue.
